calendar.trading_dates_serialization: ascending YYYY-MM-DD joined by LF with one trailing LF

hash_rule.sorted_code_set: ascending code strings joined by LF with one trailing LF

alias_anomaly_rule: flag overlapping candidate codes with identical security-basic ipoDate and identical bounded daily-state fingerprints
flag a code returned before an official code-effective boundary
flag date-specific identity conflicts not explained by inclusive list/out boundaries
historical code_name is diagnostic only and cannot authorize identity
every genuine anomaly requires a data-driven official event or remains UNRESOLVED_FAIL_CLOSED
identity_rules.official_code_semantics: SZSE bounded ChinNext stock-code semantics; source document must be hash-bound
identity_rules.selection_rule: date-specific query_all_stock code intersect type=1 and bounded official code semantics, then apply date-effective official alias events

known_at_rule.baostock_retrospective_state: bounded effective-state only; earliest safe strategy use is the next repository trading session unless an official publication/effective event proves an earlier safe boundary
known_at_rule.official_date_only_publication: effective no earlier than max(source effective date, next repository trading session after publication date)

official_evidence_rule.targeting_rule: download only documents required by detected alias or risk-warning transition boundaries

query_functions.state: baostock.query_history_k_data_plus(code, fields, start_date, end_date, frequency='d', adjustflag='3')

raw_serialization_rule.compression: gzip with mtime=0 and empty embedded filename

risk_state_rules.isST_false: NORMAL under bounded BaoStock effective-state semantics
risk_state_rules.st_transition_rule: derive contiguous isST intervals first; subtype each interval only from hash-bound SZSE/CNINFO evidence; ambiguous intervals fail closed
risk_state_rules.suspension_rule: tradestatus=0 authorizes FULL_DAY only; intraday/temporary remains UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHORIZED

storage_rule.normalized: one security master plus one combined daily bounded historical-state artifact
storage_rule.raw: one denominator stream, one security-basic stream, one daily-state stream, one query index, and targeted official documents
